row.name: AbbVie Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=34 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.39 tightness=0.91 base_volume_vs_leg=0.69 base_volume_vs_avg=0.95
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 34 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.39 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.7% vs its 20-SMA, -0.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base spans 34 sessions — nearly double Bonde's 20-session ceiling — and the chart confirms it: a wide, choppy consolidation from mid-July through mid-September with multiple overlapping bars, two distinct legs down to ~241 and back, and no tightening into the burst. RE fails (the burst bar at 1.4% is not the widest of the last five sessions), and VOL fails the mandatory 1.5x average requirement for bases over 21 sessions, with volume at only 0.7x the 50-session average on a 0.58% close-to-close gain.
claude.key_risk: The 34-session base is structurally too loose and too long; a breakout from this kind of wide, extended consolidation has poor odds of a clean 3–5 day follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless of price action — the base length and volume failures are structural disqualifiers that a gap or strong open cannot fix.

row.summary: ABBV: +0.6% on 1.1× volume out of a base 9.8% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
